candidate_sentence_map.S1: Coop Pank’s financial performance weakened in 2025 despite continued expansion in lending and customer numbers.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Net profit declined by 11% to €28.7 million from €32.2 million in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: The main pressure came from the lower-interest-rate environment, which reduced interest income and margins faster than the bank’s business volumes increased.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: Net interest income fell to €73.3 million from €77.6 million, while net interest margin narrowed from 3.8% to 3.0%.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: Total net operating income decreased to €79.4 million from €81.9 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: Fee and commission income increased modestly, with net fee and commission income rising to €4.5 million from €4.3 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: Net other income also improved to €1.5 million from near zero in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: These gains only partly offset higher operating costs, which increased to €41.5 million from €40.6 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: Payroll expenses rose as the average number of employees increased to approximately 452 from 433, while information-system and legal expenses also grew.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: The cost-to-income ratio consequently increased to 52.3% from 49.6%.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: Credit loss allowances declined to €3.3 million from €4.6 million, reflecting the continued low-risk quality of the loan portfolio.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: However, the effective tax rate increased to 17% from 12%, and income tax expense rose to €5.8 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: The net loan portfolio increased by 19% to €2.114 billion, exceeding €2 billion for the first time.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Business lending grew by 27% to €986 million, while mortgage and other private loans increased by 17% to €863 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: Customer deposits rose by 9% to €2.047 billion, supported by an 11% increase in demand deposits and an 8% increase in term deposits.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: The customer base expanded by 19,000, or 9%, to 227,000.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: Loan quality remained at a low-risk level, although total loan-loss allowances increased slightly to €19.4 million from €18.6 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S19: The bank strengthened and diversified its funding during the year by issuing €250 million of four-year covered bonds, the first tranche under a €750 million programme.
candidate_sentence_map.S20: It also entered into an agreement with the European Investment Bank Group that is expected to enable up to €249 million of new business lending through capital relief, and signed a €5 million subordinated loan agreement with the European Energy Efficiency Fund.
candidate_sentence_map.S21: Profitability ratios declined alongside earnings: return on equity fell to 12.9% from 16.2%, and return on assets to 1.2% from 1.6%.
candidate_sentence_map.S22: Capital ratios also decreased moderately, but the Group remained compliant with all regulatory requirements.
candidate_sentence_map.S23: The bank paid €7.2 million in dividends for 2024 and proposed a 2025 dividend of €0.065 per share, totaling €6.7 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S24: Overall, 2025 combined strong balance-sheet growth and improved funding capacity with weaker earnings caused primarily by lower interest rates and reduced margins.

evaluation.label: Generally yes
evaluation.justification: The candidate summary adequately covers the core material meaning of K1 (profit decline, ROE, cost-to-income), K2 (loan portfolio growth), K3 (customer deposits), K4 (customer base growth), K6 (bond issuance and EIB guarantee), K10 (dividends), and K11 (EEEF subordinated loan). However, it omits the strategic targets of K5, the capital ratios and regulatory compliance details of K7, the sustainability initiatives of K8, the new services and products of K9, and the management board appointment of K12. While several HIGH importance criteria are missing, the main financial performance picture is captured, justifying a 'Generally yes' rating.
